evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~3.03-3.08 Torr throughout ramp at Ar 100 sccm, even as T rose to 750 C
Pressure rose steadily during growth: 3.072 → 3.094 → 3.131 → 3.176 → 3.234 → 3.264 Torr, with no change in setpoint
MFC reading stable ~99-101 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from extra inflow
Exhaust O2 stays low at 2-5 ppm, so no sign of air getting in (argues against a seal leak)
Thermocouple holding 750 C with steady heater power, so temperature does not explain the rise

args.missing_evidence: Normal-run reference for growth-stage pressure; a check of exhaust line/valve conductance, or a brief Ar flow step to see if the pressure response shows restricted pumping; post-run characterization.
